tools.name: list_worktrees
tools.description: List Git worktrees in this project with registered IDs. Entries without an ID must be registered before delegation. Use git_status with a registered worktree ID to inspect changes. File and command tools remain bound to this turn's directory.

tools.name: create_worktree
tools.description: Create and register an isolated worktree and new branch in the execution Node's managed directory, starting from this turn's worktree. Use head and index_revision from git_status as expected_head and expected_index. include_changes defaults to false; set true to copy uncommitted changes. Use the returned ID with spawn_agent.worktree. This does not move the parent or merge changes. Invoke directly under the current permission mode; do not request approval through ask_user.

tools.name: register_worktree
tools.description: Register an existing Git worktree from this project's repository. Use its absolute path from list_worktrees; the returned ID can be passed to spawn_agent. No checkout or session is moved.

tools.name: remove_worktree
tools.description: Remove an unused, clean linked worktree, keeping its branch. Use head and branch from git_status or list_worktrees as expected_head and expected_branch. Main, dirty, locked, running or history-owned worktrees cannot be removed. Never delete session history to bypass a conflict. This does not merge changes. Invoke directly under the current permission mode; do not request approval through ask_user.
